prompt: launch video for a note-taking app

plan.title: Meet the note app that keeps up with your thoughts
plan.description: A one-minute launch video for a new note-taking app, built for people whose ideas get lost across apps, paper and screenshots. It shows the problem, the idea, how it works in three steps and how to start.

beats.narration: You had a great idea this morning. Where is it now? Scribbled on a sticky note, buried in a screenshot, lost in a chat with yourself. Good thoughts shouldn't be this hard to find again.

props.alt: cluttered workspace with papers and notes

beats.narration: So we built a place where every thought has a home. Write it, speak it or paste it in. It lands in one calm, clean space, ready whenever you need it.

props.text: One calm place for every thought you have.

beats.narration: It takes three simple steps. First, capture. Jot down your thoughts as they come. Second, organize. Keep your notes in order. Third, revisit. Come back to them whenever you need them.

Imagine opening one app and finding exactly what you were thinking last week. Less hunting, more doing. That is what a good note should feel like. Download the app today, and give your ideas somewhere to stay.
